2610.12666.title: Incremental Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Human-in-the-Loop Decision Support
2610.12666.paper_summary: We introduce iRAG, a human-in-the-loop decision-support system combining Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Hybrid Decision-Making. Unlike conventional RAG systems, relying on static Knowledge Bases (KBs), our proposal addresses settings where the KB is initially empty and is progressively populated through human decisions. The system stores previous decisions as retrievable precedents and moves from silent observation to evidence-grounded contestation and, finally, to autonomous handling with abstention. Against an independent baseline, iRAG matches final-decision error under 10% drift without retrieval decay and reduces it under 40% drift across all configurations. Retrieval decay improves performance on changed knowledge while increasing error on stable knowledge, evidencing a stability--plasticity trade-off rather than a general advantage. Human oversight is an architectural provision of the workflow; its usability with real human users remains to be evaluated.
2610.12666.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 iRAG，一個結合檢索增強生成（RAG）與混合決策的人工介入決策支持系統。與依賴靜態知識庫（KB）的傳統 RAG 系統不同，我們的提案針對最初為空的 KB 並通過人類決策逐步填充的情境。該系統將先前的決策存儲為可檢索的先例，並從靜默觀察轉向基於證據的質疑，最終實現自主處理並選擇不參與。在獨立基準下，iRAG 在最終決策誤差上匹配低於 10% 的漂移，且在所有配置中將其降低至 40% 漂移以下。檢索衰退在變更知識上提高了性能，但在穩定知識上增加了誤差，顯示出穩定性與可塑性之間的權衡，而非一般優勢。人類監督是工作流程的一個架構性配置；其在真實人類用戶中的可用性尚待評估。
2610.12666.author: Federico Mazzoni et.al.
